Deploy the current project

Usage: deployer deploy [OPTIONS] --env <ENV> [TARGET]...

Arguments:
  [TARGET]...  Targets to deploy

Options:
  -e, --env <ENV>        Target environment [possible values: dev, staging, prod]
      --dry-run          Only print what would happen
      --tag=<TAG>        Release tag
  -j, --jobs <N>         Parallel jobs
  -h, --help             Print help
